method: Fresh direct official HTML retrieval and web retrieval on October 10 for every pricing policy, before provider discovery. Existing public schedules, scope, rates and dates were compared with pricing.json. Codex checked only as an operator-disabled personal timer, not an official pricing policy. Complete verification dates advance only for 24 fully verified profiles. Six partial profiles, one route-unverified profile and disabled Codex retain their prior verification dates. Public documentation verification is not settled-account billing verification.
summary: MiMo's newly updated deprecation notice now announces automatic V2.5-to-V2.6 routing on October 14. The table says 10:00 Beijing, while its note and site banner say 18:00 Beijing. Add both published times and replacement-model billing to an explicit warning; do not invent an exact transition. Old IDs expire October 21 at 10:00 Beijing.

All current clock windows and multipliers otherwise match main. Saturday October 10 remains off-peak for DeepSeek and B.AI, despite China's makeup working day: both providers define weekdays as Monday through Friday.
No new provider with a sufficiently precise, independently verified clock policy was found. Discovery results mostly repeat existing DeepSeek schedules or discuss request queue/batch discounts.
Branch only: no merge, push or deployment. Remove the temporary worktree after committing.
uncertainties: DeepSeek table still lists separate Pro 0813 pricing while its September 10 routing announcement says Pro requests route to Flash until a future V4.1 Pro launch; current Pro scope remains unverified.
AIHubMix aggregate schedule/rates differ from named routes and automatic fallback is documented; no universal schedule or weekend/holiday rule can be guaranteed.
Z.ai's expired Flash campaign did not specify the final October 7 overnight cutoff. Historical interpretation is retained, not newly certified.
Tencent October 31 Flash 0731 retirement notice does not explicitly cover Vendor Direct; do not assume coverage.
SiliconFlow Hunyuan daily 09:00–18:00 price split lacks a confirmed time zone; no inferred provider added.
Swarms Black Friday free-request promotion lacks a published exact time-zone/start instant; not encoded.
Chinese holiday exceptions cover 2026 only. Do not infer them for other providers. No settled-account pricing verification performed.

Baidu busy/idle time zone remains unstated. The Pro 0813 cache-price date label says September 9–October 30 without a year, exact cutoff or subsequent rates; these gaps are explicitly exposed rather than filled in.
MiMo's October 9 update conflicts on the October 14 automatic-routing time: 10:00 in the table, 18:00 in the note/banner. No guessed timed rate override; October 21 10:00 ID expiry is consistent.
